title: Navigation to a verified empty main fails without guessing unread targets
steps: Read the same-origin navigation and footer target with an empty semantic main, then retarget it to the populated native page.
Repeat with unread, loading, hidden, form/media, query-distinct and trailing-slash-distinct destinations, a submenu toggle and an off-site redirect.
expect: A navigation item to the read-confirmed empty main fails cta-real and identifies its source and destination; a populated target passes.
Unknown or uninspected targets stay in unknown coverage metadata, without claiming their main is empty; query, slash and redirect identity remain separate.
evidence: Local WordPress /contact/ renders only header/footer while /contact/contact-us/ contains the business contact details.
fence: The browser reports semantic main evidence separately from shared shell text; the judge uses only successful reads of the exact destination.

tests: cta-real: ordinary navigation cannot lead to a read-confirmed empty main
cta-real: unread, unknown, failed and query-distinct navigation destinations are not judged empty
cta-real: footer fragments and redirected aliases retain destination identity without trusting an off-site read
